basic_profile.bio: I'm a dedicated Royale High player and trader based in the UK, known for my fair trades and active participation in the RoyaleHighTrading community. Outside of my virtual endeavors, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to be online during late afternoons and evenings (GMT). I'm a night owl, often browsing and interacting on Reddit in the wee hours. I enjoy strategy games and occasionally dabble in online poker. In a long-term relationship, my partner is supportive of my gaming passion but prefers offline adventures. I dislike unfair trades and scammers, and I'm always ready to help newcomers to the community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of Royale High trading dynamics, acquired through years of active participation and trade negotiations. My expertise is self-taught, driven by an initial curiosity that blossomed into a full-fledged passion. I also possess a solid grasp of graphic design principles, courtesy of a degree in Fine Arts and subsequent freelance work.
